scope: From the young person's seat: s 3(1) juvenile; Part 4 Division 9 -- ss 120 (limbs (1)(b), (1)(f), (2)), 121(1), (3), (4)-(8), (7a), (10), (11), 122(1)-(4), 122A, 123, 124, 125(1)(b), (2)(b), 126; s 167(3), (4). Licensing, s 119 general offences, banned drinkers and the rest of the Act out
seat: the young person (a juvenile, under 18): 'May I buy and drink alcohol now?'

roles: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
I am a parent, guardian or other adult with a young person
I hold a licence, manage licensed premises, or sell or serve liquor

situation_parameters.name: the area is declared out of bounds to juveniles now
situation_parameters.description: Whether notices at the entrance declare the area out of bounds to juveniles at this time
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: Can I be made to leave this out-of-bounds area
Have I committed an offence by not leaving this out-of-bounds area

situation_parameters.name: someone has given or sold me alcohol, or offered to
situation_parameters.description: Whether someone has sold, supplied or given you alcohol, or has offered to
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: Is it lawful for this person to give me alcohol at this place
What is the most the person who gave me alcohol can be fined
Could the person who sold me liquor rely on believing I was 18

situation_parameters.name: I was sent to get liquor
situation_parameters.description: Whether you were sent there to get liquor
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: Did the person who sent me to get liquor commit an offence

situation_parameters.name: I work, or want to work, selling, supplying or serving liquor
situation_parameters.description: Whether you are employed or engaged, or want to be, to sell, supply or serve liquor on licensed premises or premises with an occasional licence or permit (s 121(10))
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: May I be employed to sell, supply or serve liquor

situation_parameters.name: an authorised person has asked my age, or for evidence of it
situation_parameters.description: Whether, on licensed or regulated premises, the licensee, a manager, a staff member or a police officer has asked you to state your age or to show evidence of it (s 126)
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: Can I be required to show evidence of my age here
Does what I showed count as evidence of my age
Can I be made to leave because I did not prove my age
Can my ID be confiscated by the authorised person
Have I committed an offence in answering the request for my age

situation_parameters.name: I have been required to leave, or removed from, the premises
situation_parameters.description: Whether you were required to leave, or were removed from, licensed or regulated premises under s 126
situation_parameters.role: I am a young person (under 18, or about to turn 18)
questions: Have I committed an offence by going back in within 24 hours

situation_parameters.name: I have given, or would give, alcohol to a person under 18
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have sold, supplied or given alcohol to a person under 18, or bought it for them, or are thinking of doing so (ss 121(1), (3), 122(2), 122A)
situation_parameters.role: I am a parent, guardian or other adult with a young person
questions: May I give alcohol to this young person at this place
Could I rely on believing the young person was 18
Is it an offence for me to buy liquor for a young person who asked me to

situation_parameters.name: I am, or will be, with a person under 18 on licensed or regulated premises
situation_parameters.description: Whether you are taking, or have taken, a person under 18 on to licensed premises or regulated premises, such as a hotel, tavern, cafe or venue (ss 121(4), (5), (9), 122(3))
situation_parameters.role: I am a parent, guardian or other adult with a young person
questions: Am I a responsible adult for this young person
Is it an offence for the young person to be on these licensed premises with me
Is it an offence for me to leave the young person on the licensed premises
Is it an offence for me to take the young person into this part of regulated premises

situation_parameters.name: I have sent, or would send, a person under 18 to get liquor
situation_parameters.description: Whether you have sent, or are thinking of sending, someone you know or believe to be under 18 to get liquor (s 124)
situation_parameters.role: I am a parent, guardian or other adult with a young person
questions: Is it an offence for me to send this young person to get liquor

situation_parameters.name: liquor has been, or may be, sold or supplied to a person under 18 at my business
situation_parameters.description: Whether liquor has been, or may be, sold or supplied to a person under 18 at your premises or by your business (ss 121(1), 122(2), 125)
situation_parameters.role: I hold a licence, manage licensed premises, or sell or serve liquor
questions: Is it an offence of mine that liquor is sold or supplied to this person under 18
Can I rely on believing the person was 18
Do I have the defence for regulated premises

situation_parameters.name: a person under 18 is, or wants to be, on my licensed premises
situation_parameters.description: Whether a person under 18 is, or wants to be, on your licensed premises or a part of them (s 121(4), (5))
situation_parameters.role: I hold a licence, manage licensed premises, or sell or serve liquor
questions: Is it an offence of mine that this person under 18 is on this part of my licensed premises

situation_parameters.name: I employ, or would employ, a person under 18 to sell, supply or serve liquor
situation_parameters.description: Whether you employ or engage, or would, a person under 18 to sell, supply or serve liquor (s 121(10), (11))
situation_parameters.role: I hold a licence, manage licensed premises, or sell or serve liquor
questions: Is it an offence for me to employ this person under 18 to sell, supply or serve liquor

situation_parameters.name: I suspect a person on the premises is under 18
situation_parameters.description: Whether you, as the licensee, a manager or a staff member, know or suspect on reasonable grounds that a person on the licensed or regulated premises is under 18 (s 126(1))
situation_parameters.role: I hold a licence, manage licensed premises, or sell or serve liquor
questions: May I require this person to state their age
May I require this person to show evidence of their age
Does what the person showed count as evidence of their age
May I require this person to leave for not proving their age
May I confiscate what the person showed

qa_layer.notes: NOTES.md, "Q&A layer (seat and situations as parameters)"
